forum.title: Question on VDD and VSS internal connection
forum.best_answer_content:
You can't rely on the continuity test for that as not all VDD pins are internally connected together. Same case for VSS.

I've just tested it in a free chip.

Hope I answered your question.
forum.content_text:
Should each vdd pin of the stm32f407zgt6 read continuity like the blue pill on multimeter, are they internally connected within the chip or separated? Similary for all the vss pins are they also all connected vss inside stm32f407zgt6

Thanks
forum.author: OLAMIDESET

scraped_replies.html:
You can't rely on the continuity test for that as not all VDD pins are internally connected together. Same case for VSS.

scraped_replies.author: mƎALLEm

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @OLAMIDESET and welcome to the ST community,

All VDD and VSS pins should be connected outside the chip (if this is the background of your question).
scraped_replies.author: mƎALLEm

scraped_replies.html: I appreciate your prompt response. I know that all the vdd and vss pins should be connected and grounded with 100nf ceramic capacitor but what I'm saying is that before connecting any component at all, should each vdd pin read continuity on a multimeter and same thing with vss(are all vss internally grounded)?
